design_patterns_learned.name: Theming & Color Palette
design_patterns_learned.description: The application uses a dual-theme approach (light/dark mode) with a consistent color palette across all components. Colors are semantically named to define their purpose.

primary_colors.info: Accent color for interactive elements, highlights (blue/teal hues).
primary_colors.success: For positive feedback, installed states (green hues).
primary_colors.error: For negative feedback, destructive actions (red hues).

background_colors.surface_light: Main content surfaces, cards, input backgrounds in light theme.
background_colors.surface_dark: Main content surfaces, cards, input backgrounds in dark theme.
background_colors.secondary_light: Slightly darker/recessed backgrounds (e.g., chat background, settings page outer container) in light theme.
background_colors.secondary_dark: Slightly darker/recessed backgrounds in dark theme.
background_colors.tertiary_light: Even darker/more recessed backgrounds, hover states, sub-containers in light theme.
background_colors.tertiary_dark: Even darker/more recessed backgrounds, hover states, sub-containers in dark theme.

text_colors.text_light: Primary text color in light theme.
text_colors.text_dark: Primary text color in dark theme.
text_colors.text_light_sub: Subtle/secondary text color (e.g., descriptions, placeholders) in light theme.
text_colors.text_dark_sub: Subtle/secondary text color in dark theme.

border_colors.border_light: Default border color in light theme.
border_colors.border_dark: Default border color in dark theme.

design_patterns_learned.name: Consistent Typography
design_patterns_learned.description: A clear hierarchy of font sizes and weights is used for headings, body text, and labels.

details.font_family: Default sans-serif, with 'fraunces' for specific display elements (like initial greeting).
details.font_sizes: Small (xs, sm), medium (base), large (lg, xl, 3xl) with consistent usage.

design_patterns_learned.name: Rounded Corners & Soft Shadows
design_patterns_learned.description: Elements consistently use rounded corners and subtle shadows to create a modern, friendly, and elevated feel.

details.border_radius: Typically `rounded-lg` (8px) or `rounded-2xl` (16px) for cards, modals, and larger containers; `rounded-full` for buttons and badges.
details.shadows: Subtle `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, or `shadow-lg` for interactive elements, cards, and modals.

design_patterns_learned.name: Interactive States (Hover, Focus, Active, Disabled)
design_patterns_learned.description: Clear visual feedback is provided for user interactions.

details.hover: Opacity changes (`hover:opacity-95`), background color changes (`hover:bg-info/90`, `hover:bg-tertiary-light`), underline for links (`hover:underline`).
details.focus: Outline removal (`focus:outline-none`) as borders/shadows often indicate focus.
details.disabled: Reduced opacity (`opacity-50`) and `cursor-not-allowed` for disabled states.
details.active: Subtle background changes or darker shades for active elements.

design_patterns_learned.name: Micro-interactions & Animations (Framer Motion)
design_patterns_learned.description: Subtle, deliberate animations enhance the user experience, providing visual cues for changes in state or content.

details.presence_animations: Used with `AnimatePresence` for mounting/unmounting components (e.g., chat bubbles, modals, dropdowns) with `initial`, `animate`, `exit` states.
details.layout_animations: Smooth transitions for layout changes (`layout` prop).
details.spring_transitions: Often `type: "spring"` with `stiffness` and `damping` for natural, bouncy movements.
details.opacity_transitions: Fade-ins and fade-outs for visibility changes.
details.scale_transitions: Subtle scaling (`scale: 0.95` to `scale: 1`) for pop-up elements.
details.translate_transitions: Vertical translation (`y: 10` or `y: -50`) for entry/exit of elements.

design_patterns_learned.name: Iconography
design_patterns_learned.description: Lucide React icons are used consistently for visual communication, often paired with text.

details.size: Typically `size={16}` or `size={18}` for inline text, `size={20}` for buttons, `size={32}` for prominent features.
details.color: Often `text-info` for primary actions/features, or `text-text-light-sub` for secondary/decorative icons.

design_patterns_learned.name: Component Abstraction & Reusability
design_patterns_learned.description: Common UI elements are extracted into reusable components (e.g., Dropdown, Badge, ModelCard, Modal) to maintain consistency and reduce code duplication.

details.Dropdown: Custom selection component with consistent styling.
details.Badge: Small, informative labels with distinct styling.
details.ModelCard: Standardized display for individual AI models.
details.ModelDetailsModal: A generic modal structure adapted for displaying detailed model information.
details.LoadingState: Consistent visual indication for loading data (e.g., animated `Loader2` icon, `LoadingBubble`).

design_patterns_learned.name: Responsive Design
design_patterns_learned.description: Components are designed to adapt to different screen sizes.

details.flexbox_grid: Extensive use of flexbox and CSS Grid (`sm:flex-row`, `md:grid-cols-2`) for adaptive layouts.
details.max_widths: Using `max-w-xl`, `max-w-2xl` to constrain content width on larger screens.

design_patterns_learned.name: Feedback Mechanisms (Toasts)
design_patterns_learned.description: Non-intrusive notifications for user actions or system status.

details.react-hot-toast: Used for success, error, and loading messages. Consistent styling for toast messages.

design_patterns_learned.name: Empty States / Placeholders
design_patterns_learned.description: Friendly and informative messages for when there is no content.

details.greeting: Personalized greetings based on time of day in chat component.
details.ComingSoonPlaceholder: A dedicated component for features under development, with clear messaging and an icon.
details.NoSearchResults: Centered text message for empty search results.
